injury_index_observation.index_rule_quoted: NBA teams must report information concerning player injuries... By 5 p.m. local time the day before a game (other than the second day of a back-to-back), teams must designate a participation status... In addition, teams are required to submit a game-day injury report between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time (and between 8 and 10 a.m. for tip-offs 5 p.m. or earlier) on game days (besides the second game of a back-to-back). Reports are updated on a continual basis throughout the day.
